run_mnist_training: run the MNIST CNN training loop with Hydra config and Dora experiment tracking
train_cnn_model: train a PyTorch CNN model on MNIST data using Adadelta optimizer and StepLR scheduler
test_model_accuracy: test the trained MNIST model and log average loss and accuracy to the logger
review_Net_class: review the Net CNN class with two conv layers, dropout, and two fully connected layers
refactor_train_function: refactor the train function to support custom loss functions or different logging intervals
